text: Crude prices rise sharply while maritime transit through a primary corridor remains halted. Public statements alternate between escalation and negotiation without convergence. Market pricing aligns rapidly across benchmarks under constrained flow conditions.

meta.note: Contest operates across signaling layer; compression reflects physical flow restriction anchoring price response.

text: Delivery volume falls below expectations with reliance concentrated in a limited set of vehicle models. Legacy product lines phase out while new categories remain non-contributory. Market position is contested across global EV segments under shifting demand conditions.

meta.note: Contest reflects external competitive pressure; compression reflects internal product concentration rather than total output collapse.
